method: Independent frozen source inventory compared against installed-backend baseline. Two deep papers: all 18 scientific resource PNGs visually inspected, three table CSV/HTML/JSON structures read, 20 preselected cells checked at semantic row/column in all three formats. Five inventory-only papers: printed kind/number/page/caption association and warnings checked; six antibiotic subpanel PNGs also viewed to verify fragmentation, without certifying complete crop/text/cell accuracy. Publisher marks classified using source page placement and representative logo/badge PNGs. No parser rerun, product edit or modification of source/ground truth/baseline.

field_semantics.crop_complete: Deep review only: all scientific illustration panels/axes or table grid body visible across matched exports. Captions are assessed separately; exclusion of explanatory footnotes is explicitly noted. null means not reviewed at this level.
field_semantics.correct_number: Every matched resource segment has the logical printed number; unnumbered fragments make this false.
field_semantics.caption_association: correct/partial/missing refers to association, not exact fidelity of every mathematical glyph or unit.
field_semantics.sample_cell_status: exact: expected string at explicitly mapped semantic row/column in JSON, CSV and expanded HTML grid; normalized: whitespace-only normalization; mismatch: content differs; ambiguous_missing: semantic row/column absent. Missing groups here are confirmed omissions, not merely unidentified tokens.
field_semantics.auxiliary_logo: Publisher logos/CrossMark/footer marks are gallery noise, separately counted from fabricated scientific objects. Matched panel fragments are assigned to their true parent object and are not double-counted as extra resources.
field_semantics.indices: Physical PDF pages and exported row/col indices are zero-based.
field_semantics.scope_limit: Inventory match or format/HTTP success is not content accuracy. No new quantitative accuracy claim is made for unselected cells or five inventory-only papers. Baseline is 0.2.1; no 0.2.2 correction result is included.

conclusion: All 32 expected logical scientific objects have at least one matched resource, but this is not full accuracy: four Figures fragment; ecological Table 2 loses A/B; two deep Figure crops have minor clipping; CellFIT table structure and six source-encoded plus/minus cells need human correction.
